evidence: This is an advisory/knowledge skill whose deliverable is expert guidance, producible as text. Read SKILL.md and references/harness-protocol.md (references/evidence.md also present; glob confirmed all three skill files exist, so no skill_files_missing). Verified by cross-checking every recommendation against SKILL.md tables (Harness Owns the Invariants; gotchas 1-9) and harness-protocol.md Budget Controller Defaults/Parse-Back Rules/Receipts; every symptom resolved to a correct, specific skill mechanism with no gaps and no invented facts. No code execution, no binaries, and no network were needed; task done entirely with read/write/edit of text files, within the office-assistant runtime and all safety rules.
